pageTitle: The "Hilichurl Support Group" Has Officially Been Established, Join to Win Exquisite Merchandise!
name: The "Hilichurl Support Group" Has Officially Been Established, Join to Win Exquisite Merchandise!
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Have you ever ran into trouble during your travels? For example, you don't know where to start when faced with a difficult puzzle? Or you don't know how to build a character? Or that time when you discovered a great party composition strategy and didn't know who to share it with? To help you navigate the land of Teyvat more smoothly, I have decided to establish the "Hilichurl Support Group"! Whether you're a budding new Traveler who doesn't know where to start, or an avid Traveler who is willing to share your gaming experiences, you can join a team to help one another. I have also prepared exquisite merchandise rewards for Travelers who participate actively~
